integrity: The general proof is structural. The bundled exhaustive graph verifier is a replay of the local renaming/pullback construction and is not used to infer the infinite/general theorem.
scientific_limitations: The theorem assumes closure under all isomorphic copies and establishes ordinary bitotal bisimulation, not necessarily the stronger iso-bisimulation. The synthesis is elementary and may exist as uncatalogued folklore.
title: Embedding potentialism equals inclusion potentialism on every isomorphism-closed class
